title: Jesus Forever Yours App | Daily Love Letters from God
meta_description: Hear God's voice every morning. A daily love letter from God, the verse of the day and a prayer, the whole Bible in NLT and KJV, and Bible Buddy. Free on iPhone & Android.
ld_description: Hear God's voice every morning. A daily love letter from God, the verse of the day and a prayer, the whole Bible with Deep Study, Christian verse carousels, Bible Buddy for your Bible questions, and the Forever Yours devotional by Rose Renuu.
lead: A personal love letter from your Heavenly Father, with a verse and a prayer, waiting for you each day.
appstore_aria: Download Jesus Forever Yours on the App Store
play_aria: Get Jesus Forever Yours on Google Play
phone_aria: The Jesus Forever Yours app: a love letter from God, the verse of the day, a prayer, verse carousels and the Bible
card_letter_p: A short letter from your Heavenly Father every morning, rooted in Scripture.
card_prayer_p: The verse of the day and a new prayer to carry with you.
card_bible_p: Scroll the Bible one verse at a time, and go deeper with Deep Study.
card_buddy_p: A gentle Bible chat companion for your questions, with Scripture and prayer.
card_carousel_p: Beautiful verse carousels to save and share.
card_devotional_p: Read the Forever Yours devotional, one love letter a day, right in the app.
book_p: The devotional by Rose Renuu. 24 love letters from God, each paired with Scripture.
a1: A daily love letter from God, a verse and a prayer for the day, and the whole Bible, all in one quiet app.
a2: Yes. The app is free to download and every day brings a new love letter. Pro unlocks every Bible translation, 50x more Bible Buddy chat, Deep Study, unlimited carousel saves, digital devotionals, and Scan & Search.
a3: NLT and KJV are free. BSB, WEB, and ASV come with Pro.
a4: Rose Renuu, the author of the Forever Yours devotional, through Rose Renuu LLC.
